summary: Plan written: classify the run outcome inside the Claude Code plugin (honor is_error at all three decision sites, allowlist-based transient classification setting AdapterError.retryable explicitly) and make agent-step's existing retry loop result-aware so it never re-runs work that already landed. No contract or schema change.

details.approach: Plugin-local classification on the existing AdapterMethodError/retryable contract; rejected a typed run-outcome on AgentAdapter (reinvents a working channel, and would be a public_api change gating the fix for no benefit).
details.core_change: agent-step.ts: one guard so the retry loop bails when a valid session-result.json already exists — resetResultFile runs once before the loop, so a naive retry would overwrite a good result and turn a passing run into no_result. This is a correctness fix, not just a cost fix.
found_beyond_prior_phases: resultEvent['result'] is not always a string (the repo's own mock emits {type,text}); the error message must reuse the existing extractContent helper, not String(event['result']) — otherwise AC#5 is silently gutted.
The salvage path sets this.lastRateLimits before resolving; the new reject path must set it too, or a rate-limited run drops its quota headers.
details.accepted_regression: Cost is no longer attributed for errored runs (a throwing run never reaches emitAgentCost). Fixing it needs a spend field on the adapter error contract (public_api). Documented as a follow-up; the status quo — booking a failed run as a successful $2.28 run AND burning the phase — is strictly worse.
follow_ups: Gemini CLI and OpenCode share the defect class; not fixed here (no live evidence of their error shapes — a test against a guessed shape proves nothing).
A terminal run error still rides the daemon's agent_unavailable ladder (bounded, escalates; a cleaner taxonomy is a Core-wide change).

decisions.summary: Also fix the adjacent no-result-event site (claude-code-agent.ts:503), which is the same dropped-connection bug one line away from the two sites named in the acceptance criteria.
decisions.chosen: Mark the exit-0-with-no-result-event path retryable, in the same file the fix already touches.
decisions.reasoning: A connection dropped before the CLI emits its result line is a clean exit with a truncated stream — it lands at :503, currently retryable:false, and would keep burning phases exactly as the issue describes. One field, inside a file already being changed, serving the issue's stated goal. Leaving it means knowingly shipping the same defect next door.
